controls.description: Check game files for this setup option, platform and channel. Changing filters alone does not scan files or install anything.

failure.catalogMismatch: The complete game-file observation no longer matches this context. Check again.
failure.catalogTooLarge: This catalog is too large to check all game files at once. Game-file filters are unavailable.
failure.selectionMismatch: The game-file observation no longer matches this selection. Check again.

filterObservation.heading: Game-file filter results
filterObservation.scope: These results are used by catalog filters. Setup and launch perform their own checks.

existingAndFuture.detail: Portcove installs each eligible game once its files and requirements are ready. It never starts a game.
existingAndFuture.label: Set up eligible games already here and any added later

folderSetup.failed_one: <game/> didn't finish setting up after {{count}} try: <reason/>. Portcove tries again when the game's files or setup change.
folderSetup.failed_other: <game/> didn't finish setting up after {{count}} tries: <reason/>. Portcove tries again when the game's files or setup change.

futureOnly.detail: Portcove remembers every file in this folder now and leaves those games alone, even if it recognizes them later.
futureOnly.label: Only set up games added later

off.detail: Portcove only shows what it finds here.
off.label: Don't set up games from this folder automatically

folderSetup.sharedFiles: More than one game can use some files here. Choose which one to set up; until you do, Portcove waits.

discoverOnly.detail: Portcove doesn't notify you about this game or install it.
discoverOnly.label: Only show it in discovery

intent.failed: The last automatic setup didn't finish: <reason/>. Portcove tries again when the game's files, catalog or requirements change.

ignored.detail: Portcove doesn't suggest, notify about or set up this game.
ignored.label: Ignore this game

intent.legend: When this game's files are ready

notify.detail: Portcove tells you when it can be installed, and again only if its setup changes. Nothing is installed.
notify.label: Tell me when it's ready

setUpWhenReady.detail: Portcove installs it without asking again once its files and requirements are ready. It never starts the game. Choose another option to stop.
setUpWhenReady.label: Set it up when it's ready

intent.uninstalled: You uninstalled this game, so Portcove won't set it up or notify you about it until you choose an option again.

preliminary.description: These files are not exact matches. Validation has not run, and compatibility is not confirmed. Review a selection before deciding whether to save its location.
preliminary.heading: Preliminary selections
preliminary.inconsistent: Selection details are unavailable or inconsistent. Search again before reviewing this file.
preliminary.label: Preliminary game-file selections

query.channelScope: Channel: <channel/>. This check observes connected files; setup and launch still require their own reviews and prerequisites.
query.heading: Game files for this setup or launch option
query.label: Selected route game files

ready.heading: Ready for you
ready.label: Games ready for you
ready.update: <game/> has an update available: <version/>. Nothing was downloaded or changed.
ready.updateUnknownVersion: <game/> has an update available: a newer version. Nothing was downloaded or changed.

reason.completeCompatibleObservation: A complete set of compatible game files was found for this setup or launch option.
reason.contractNotReviewed: File requirements have not been reviewed for this setup or launch option.
reason.explicitEmptyRequirements: This action needs no files added to Portcove. The game may still ask for original files.
reason.identityNotAdmitted: These game files have not been accepted for this setup or launch option.
reason.noConnectedRegistration: No saved game-file location is connected for this setup or launch option.
reason.observationStale: The file-check result is out of date. Check again.
reason.observationUnavailable: No current file-check result is available.
reason.profileContextChanged: The selected game files or setup option changed. Check again.
reason.releaseNotBound: We haven’t confirmed whether this file-check result applies to the selected version.
reason.routeNotOffered: The selected route is not offered.
reason.storageAbsenceUnconfirmed: Portcove could not confirm whether the files are present. They are not confirmed missing.
reason.variantNotSupported: The observed file variant does not match this route.

reuse.choosePort: Choose a port for these files

error.locationChanged: The saved file location changed. Refresh before updating it.
error.profileMissing: Refresh the library to review this file's requirements.
error.registrationChanged: The saved game-file location changed. Refresh the library and check it again.
error.repairFailed: <core/> Location repair needs the same original content. Choose the moved original; check different files separately.

reuse.heading: Use saved original files
reuse.intro: Choose original files you’ve already added to see which ports may use them. The files stay where they are.
reuse.label: Reuse saved game files
reuse.noPorts: No ports offer file reuse here. Open the game’s page to check its other setup options.
reuse.refreshFirst: Refresh the library before using these saved files.
reuse.repaired: Location repaired. The saved original-file identity is unchanged: <path/>

setupReviews.choiceNote_one: One game has more than one version that can use the same files. Select the version you want; selecting all leaves them out.
setupReviews.choiceNote_other: {{count}} games have more than one version that can use the same files. Select the version you want; selecting all leaves them out.
setupReviews.countsWithChoice_one: <status>{{selected}} selected</status> · {{eligible}} eligible · {{count}} game needs a version choice
setupReviews.countsWithChoice_other: <status>{{selected}} selected</status> · {{eligible}} eligible · {{count}} games need a version choice
setupReviews.heading: Select games for setup review
setupReviews.intro: Select games to review their setup, one at a time or together. Selecting a game doesn't register files or install anything.
setupReviews.label: Selected setup reviews
setupReviews.returnNote: Return here after each review to continue.
setupReviews.unavailable: Setup review is unavailable in the current view. Refresh the workspace and folders, or check game details for remaining requirements.
setupReviews.unvalidated: Validation has not run for a selected input. Review setup requirements before continuing.

state.noFilesRequired: No files to add in Portcove

summary.cancelled: The latest check was cancelled. No current file check is available.
summary.checkingCatalog: Checking game files for the catalog…
summary.checkingSelected: Checking game files for this setup…
summary.expired: The file check expired. Check again.
summary.expiredCatalog: The previous file check expired. To check again, open Filters → Check game-file filters.
summary.expiredSelected: The previous file check expired. Use Check files for this option to check again.
summary.failed: The latest check failed. No current file check is available.
summary.informationalCatalog: The previous check is informational only. To check again, open Filters → Check game-file filters.
summary.informationalSelected: The previous check is informational only. Use Check files for this option to check again.
summary.missingCatalog: Check game files before using game-file filters.
summary.missingSelected: No current game-file check for this selection. Check again.
summary.readyCatalog: Game-file checks are ready to use in Filters.
summary.waiting: Waiting for the previous check to finish.

testResults.detailsAvailable: Download and test details are available in Technical details.
testResults.detailsMissing: The tested download or test version wasn’t recorded.
testResults.earlierNote: These are earlier test results. Passing automated checks doesn’t confirm that the game plays correctly. These platform results don’t identify the exact download, edition or file format tested.
testResults.noRecords: No matching recorded observations supplied by this report.
testResults.notConfirmed: We haven’t confirmed whether these test results apply to your files, game version, or device.
testResults.reportUnavailable: File-check report unavailable for this requirement. Catalog evidence may still exist.
testResults.unverifiedScopes: Some recorded scopes could not be verified for this requirement.
